description:
Search SafeStreets' published research on walkability, street design and pedestrian safety.

Returns the article title, summary, URL and its published questions and answers, so a finding can be quoted and linked rather than paraphrased from memory. 32 articles, each built on named public sources.

Use this when someone asks what the evidence says, wants a figure they can cite, or asks a general question about walkability that is not about one specific location.

query.description: What to look for, e.g. "car free cities", "arterial roads", "kids walking to school".
